the NYISO dayahead market is a two-stage market with generators' grouping choices in the first stage and offered capacities in the second stage; the grouping choices of generators and the offered capacities of bidding groups are significantly affected by the demand conditions; and the market prices are significantly affected by demand conditions and generators' offered capacities.

Generators' offered capacities are determined by the interaction between generators' cost functions and market prices; generators' offered capacities are affected by the market prices of the previous day; generators' bidding behavior is affected by the demand conditions.

the market prices are not only determined by the supply and demand conditions in the market, but also the bidding strategies adopted by generators.
